notes.title: Null Reference Exception Soundtrack Official Release!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953820/Null_Reference_Exception_Soundtrack/

One of the best-kept secrets of [b]Null Reference Exception[/b] is out – an epic, pulse-pounding soundtrack!

After plenty of gentle “encouragement” (read: relentless pestering), our talented team member [b]RephyZ[/b] has delivered a beautifully remastered masterpiece, and it’s finally ready for you to enjoy.

And the best part? It’s absolutely [i][u][b]FREE[/b][/u][/i]! So go ahead – dive into the music and crank up that volume! 😆

[i]- Posted with full confidence in GPT-4’s sense of humor and translation skills -[/i]

notes.title: Announcement of Official Release for Null Reference Exception
notes.notes:
[Official Release Announcement]
Null Reference Exception has officially launched at midnight on May 13, 2024 (PT).

The current version is 1.0.6.
The default language at the initial game start is set to 'English'.
Within the game options, you can choose between Korean and English.
Modify your player's modules, enhance your abilities, and try to clear the final level, the 30th stage!

notes.title: Release Announcement and Bug Notice
notes.notes:
[strike]The game is scheduled to launch in about two hours at midnight on May 13th, Korean Standard Time. [/strike]
The release button has not yet been activated, causing a delay in the launch. The game is expected to be released within today, May 13th.
Thank you for your great interest.

Currently, there are issues with data resetting, as some information is not deleted when either directly removing the game from your Steam library or deleting data files from the local folder. Please be cautious when attempting to reset the game.

In upcoming updates, we plan to prioritize the creation of a feature to delete all data in the 'Settings' menu.

Additionally, following a data reset, it is anticipated that the in-game scripts may be affected, and as a result, the game will be programmed to force quit.
